//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Your Items Are Safe -> Config

Enable Your Items Are Safe.//: Whether Your Items Are Safe is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

mustHaveItemsInInventoryForCreation.//: When enabled and a player dies without any items in their inventory, no chest or armor stand is generated.

addPlayerHeadToArmorStand.//: If a player head should be added to the armor stand. If a helmet is worn, this will be placed into the chest.

createArmorStand.//: Whether an armor stand should be created on death. If disabled, the player's gear will be placed inside the chest.

createSignWithPlayerName.//: Whether a sign should be placed on the chest with the name of the player who died there.

nameChestWithPlayerName.//: Whether the chest should be named after the player who died there. The name is shown when the chest is opened.

needChestMaterials.//: Whether materials are needed for the chest which spawns on death. This can be the actual chest or the costs in raw materials.

needArmorStandMaterials.//: Whether materials are needed for the armor stand to spawn on death. This can be the actual armor stand or the costs in raw materials.

needSignMaterials.//: Whether materials are needed for the creation of the sign when 'createSignWithPlayerName' is enabled.

ignoreStoneMaterialNeed.//: Only relevant if 'needChestAndArmorStandMaterials' is enabled. An armor stand needs 1 stone slab to be created, but I think it's alright to ignore that requirement. If enabled, no stone is needed in the inventory on death.

createChestAboveVoid.//: If a chest should be placed right above the minimum build height when a player dies in the void.

createVoidPlatform.//: If a 3x3 platform should be created below the chest above the void. 'createChestAboveVoid' must be enabled.

dimensionsToIgnore.//: Dimensions in which no chest or armor stand is created, separated by a comma. For example: 'minecraft:the_nether,minecraft:the_end'.

playerNamesToIgnore.//: Players for whom no chest or armor stand is created, separated by a comma. For example: 'Steve,Alex'.

sendMessageOnCreationFailure.//: If a message should be sent if the chest or armor stand can't be created due to missing materials.

sendMessageOnCreationSuccess.//: If a message should be sent on successful creation of the chest(s) and armor stand.

sendDeathCoordinatesInChat.//: If the player's death coordinates should be sent in the chat below the 'sendMessageOnCreationFailure'/'sendMessageOnCreationSuccess' message.

creationFailureMessage.//: The message sent on creation failure with 'sendMessageOnCreationFailure' enabled. Possible replacement values: %plankamount%, %stoneamount%.
creationFailureMessage.value: Your items are not safe due to having insufficient materials. Missing: %plankamount% planks.

creationSuccessMessage.//: The message sent on creation success with 'sendMessageOnCreationSuccess' enabled.
creationSuccessMessage.value: Your items are safe at your death location.
